name: cobol-data-exec-entry-boundary
body: The DATA DIVISION exec_block skip runs only at a data-entry boundary, and the section split in parse_data_division does not skip EXEC blocks. Limit: an EXEC block inside one data entry, between its clauses, is not recognised, and a block containing a WORD SECTION. sequence would be misread as a section header. Upgrade when a corpus shows mid-entry EXEC or such text inside a block.
